name: Horseshoes of Speed

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Shod on a mount, its Speed increases by 30 ft.
text: These iron horseshoes come in a set of four. As long as all four shoes are affixed to the hooves of a horse or similar creature, they increase the creature's Speed by 30 feet. (In the game, they quicken the party's journeys.)
